Package com.csse3200.game.components.player.abilities

Class Invisibility

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.player.PlayerAbility
com.csse3200.game.components.player.TimedPlayerAbility
com.csse3200.game.components.player.abilities.Invisibility
public final class Invisibility extends TimedPlayerAbility
Cast ability. Activating it puts an invisibility effect on the player, and for as long as that effect runs the player takes no hostile damage and hostiles cannot target them.

The ability only decides when to apply the effect. Everything that reacts to being hidden asks the status effects controller, which also runs the countdown, so nothing outside this package names this class.
